title: Attractive Runner
text: Attractive Runner. This is an attractive runner rug. We just put in hardwood flooring in our bedroom and closet. I have this in the center of the closet. It looks really nice in there. The rug is very thin and doesn't have any cushion to it. It seems to stay put pretty well and doesn't move around.
